name: Jen O'Malley Dillon

lean.basis: Career Democratic strategist: DNC executive director (2009–2011), Biden's 2020 campaign manager and White House deputy chief of staff, chair of the Biden and Harris 2024 campaigns.

photo.credit: University of Chicago Institute of Politics

source.title: File:Jen O'Malley Dillon in 2012 (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Democratic strategist; chaired Kamala Harris's 2024 presidential campaign
summary: Jen O'Malley Dillon managed Joe Biden's winning 2020 campaign, the first woman to manage a successful Democratic presidential campaign, then served as White House deputy chief of staff (2021–2024) before chairing Biden's 2024 re-election campaign and, after he withdrew, Kamala Harris's campaign. She earlier worked on Obama's 2008 campaign and transition and co-founded Precision Strategies.
